traceability.notes:
All acceptance criteria and detailed requirements in docs/stories/008.0-DEV-AUTO-FIX.story.md are fully implemented and verified.
Core auto-fix behavior is implemented in the require-story-annotation and valid-annotation-format rules: missing @story annotations on functions/methods (including TS decls and method signatures) are fixed by inserting a conservative single-line @story JSDoc above the node, and simple @story path suffix issues are normalized by appending .md or .story.md only. Both behaviors are guarded by per-rule autoFix options and, for require-story-annotation, configurable annotationTemplate/methodAnnotationTemplate options. Tests in tests/rules/auto-fix-behavior-008.test.ts explicitly cover all REQs (MISSING, FORMAT, TEMPLATE, SELECTIVE), including negative cases that ensure no fixes are applied when autoFix is false.
User-facing documentation in user-docs/api-reference.md describes these auto-fix behaviors, their safety constraints, and configuration options, matching the story’s Documentation acceptance criterion. The full Jest suite, including the dedicated Story 008.0 test file, passes (`npm test -- --runInBand --verbose`), providing execution-level confirmation that the implementation currently satisfies the specification.
Given the direct traceability between the story, the implementation (rule code and options), the tests, and the user documentation—and the passing test suite—the story is assessed as PASSED.
